label: 阶段放款凭单（Milestone Release Confirmation）

attributes.name: confirmed_at
attributes.label: confirmed_at
attributes.meaning: Server-recorded UTC business time; caller may not supply this field.

attributes.name: gross_amount_minor
attributes.label: gross_amount_minor
attributes.meaning: Gross order value from the seller order evidence. In CNY minor units (fen), never a floating-point yuan amount.

attributes.name: retention_minor
attributes.label: retention_minor
attributes.meaning: Warranty reserve; half-up rounding of gross multiplied by retention basis points. In CNY minor units (fen), never a floating-point yuan amount.

attributes.name: late_penalty_minor
attributes.label: late_penalty_minor
attributes.meaning: Half-up late penalty capped to gross minus warranty reserve, so payout cannot be negative. In CNY minor units (fen), never a floating-point yuan amount.

attributes.name: payout_minor
attributes.label: payout_minor
attributes.meaning: Final immutable seller payout, gross minus reserve minus capped penalty. In CNY minor units (fen), never a floating-point yuan amount.
